title: Riverfest approval, road paving and watermain contracts
subtitle: Demolition permits, a heritage barn rezoning, Meadows festival noise exemption, parking enforcement officers and a columbarium tender.
overview: Council approved Riverfest Elora in Bissell Park for August 18 to 20, 2023, as a Municipally Significant Event, with amplified music and a noise by-law exemption until 11:30 pm each night {{vote:m2}}. Council also granted a noise exemption for the Meadows Music Festival on June 2 and 3 {{vote:m10}}.

Council awarded three major contracts: road asphalting to E.C. King Contracting {{vote:m12}}, McNab Street watermain construction in Elora to Drexler Construction Limited {{vote:m14}}, and a columbarium for Belsyde Cemetery in Fergus to Kyber Columbarium Consulting {{vote:m13}}. A single-source award was also approved for groundwater monitoring wells {{vote:m5}}.

On planning matters, council approved a rezoning at 7450 Middlebrook Road to allow two farm businesses, including a seasonal events venue in a heritage barn {{vote:m8}}. It also approved two demolition permits on Sixth Line, a heritage permit for a garage and carport at 7224 Sideroad 10, and the appointment of parking enforcement officers from a contracted firm {{vote:m11}}.

decisions.detail: Council authorized Riverfest Elora for August 18 to 20 with amplified music, designated it a Municipally Significant Event, and exempted it from the noise by-law from 11:00 to 11:30 pm each night.
Council awarded Request for Tender #19-23 to E.C. King Contracting at $1,566,264.90 including contingency and excluding HST, and revised project funding.
Council awarded Request for Tender #20-23 to Drexler Construction Limited at $2,114,315.50 including contingency and excluding HST.
Council approved application RZ020/22 and passed the by-law to allow two farm businesses, including a seasonal events venue and an agricultural sales outlet in a heritage barn.

decisions.item: Agreement to keep house during new build
decisions.detail: Council authorized an agreement allowing the existing house at 6834 Sixth Line to remain while a new house is built.
Council authorized a by-law appointing employees of Alpha Parking Solutions as Municipal Law Enforcement Officers to enforce the Parking By-law.
Council exempted the festival from the noise by-law until 11:30 pm on June 2 and 3.
Council awarded Request for Tender #17-23 to Kyber Columbarium Consulting at $59,855.00 excluding HST.
